title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My friends went by bus for umrah last week from Riyadh via Medina when they reached near to Mecca. So is there any penalty for not doing umrah due the said reason, please advise. 2997 views Q. I want go tour for umra may i can do by my late fathers sister.Is it right according to kuran. She has been expire before 10Years ago. 1620 views Q. What should I do if I crossed the miqat multiple times during Umrah while in hayd without observing the rules of Ihram? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1926 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 26020 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My question is keeping qarza we can do urmrha or not? Question: as salaam alikum my question is keeping qarza we can do urmrha or not plz reply to me fast Answer ID: 26020 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2378/H=822/th=1431) The fact is that the states of those who take debt are not similar. In the same way, the conditions of those who give the debt also differ. It is better not to perform Umrah by taking debt. However, if you are satisfied that after coming back from the Umrah until you pay the debt the lender will not feel any pain rather he will feel pleasure in lending you money, then it is allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
